entities.name: PMID:25073972
observations: Promoter reporter assays in CHO-K1 cells found the monkey 20α-HSD AP-1 site at −281 to −274 bp was required for activation; deletion sharply reduced expression, and AP-1/Jun cotransfection increased activity of site-retaining constructs. DOI: 10.1186/1472-6750-14-71.

entities.name: AP-1 activates 20α-HSD
observations: In CHO-K1 reporter assays, the monkey 20α-HSD promoter AP-1 motif (−281 to −274) was essential for transcriptional activity; removal reduced signal to control levels, supporting positive regulation by AP-1.
